senses.gloss:
चेतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be collected or gathered,
to be piled up.
चेतव्य चेतव्य. See p. 322, col. 2.
1. चेतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, an observer, guardian.
2. चेतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. a revenger.
चेतृ चेतृ, चेत्या. See 2. and 3. चि, p. 322.
चेत्तृ, ता, m., Ved. an observer, a guardian.
चेत्या, f., Ved. revenge, punishment.
चेत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. observable, perceivable.

चेतक, अस्, ई, अम्, causing to think, reminding;
what thinks or feels, sentient; (ई), f. the yellow
myrobalan, = हरीतकी, Terminalia Chebula; or =
जाती-फल, Jasminum Grandiflorum.
चेतक चेतक. See p. 325, col. 2.

चेतन, अस्, ई, अम्, visible, conspicuous, distin-
guished, excellent; percipient, observing, conscious,
sentient, intelligent; alive, living, feeling; (अस्), m.
a living and sentient being, a man; self, soul, mind;
(आ), f. consciousness, understanding, sense, intelli-
gence, wisdom, reflection; (अम्), n. appearance;
the thinking principle, the mind; [cf. अ-चेतन,
निश्-च्˚, वि-च्˚, स-च्˚, चैतन्य.]
—चेतन-ता, f. or
चेतन-त्व, अम्, n. consciousness, the state or con-
dition of an observing and conscious being.
—चेतना-
चेतन (˚न-अच्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, animate and inanimate.
—चेतना-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having consciousness,
knowing, understanding, reasonable.
चेतनकी, f. = चेतकी.
चेतनीया, f. a kind of medicinal herb, = ऋद्धि.

चेतय, अस्, आ, अम्, observing, conscious, sentient,
living.

चेतयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, sentient, reflecting,
conscious.

चेतयान, अस्, आ, अम्, understanding, having sense,
sensible, conscious, sentient.
चेतयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be observed or thought.

चेतयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, observing, perceiving,
sentient.

चेतस्, अस्, n. bright appearance, Ved. (Sāy. a re-
verent mind); consciousness, intelligence, the sentient
or thinking soul, heart, mind, intellect, the faculty
of reasoning or understanding; will; [cf. अ-चेतस्,
दभ्र-च्˚, धीर-च्˚, नाना-च्˚, लघु-च्˚, वि-च्˚, स-
च्˚, सु-च्˚.]
—चेतो-भव, अस्, m. or चेतो-भू, ऊस्, m.
love, the deity of love.
—चेतो-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
endowed with consciousness, living.
—चेतो-विकार,
अस्, m. disturbance of mind, emotion.
—चेतो-विकारिन्,
ई, इणी, इ, disturbed in mind, moved.
चेतस् चेतस्, &c. See p. 325, col. 2.
चेतस at the end of an adv. comp. = चेतस्.
चेत् चेत्. See चेद् below.
चेतसक चेतसक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a place.

चेतिष्ठ चेतिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (superl. of
चित्र, q. v.), very brilliant &c., especially an epithet
of Agni.
